en: Black‑and‑white street scene showing a cobblestone road lined with multi‑story buildings and shops on both sides. People walk along the sidewalks and in the street. At the far end of the street stands a larger, more ornate building framed by trees. The overall style and clothing suggest an early‑20th‑century European town. In the lower left corner, white printed text identifies the view as 'Uddevalla, Kungsgatan.'
